item.title: Understanding WCAG: Making digital spaces welcoming for everyone
item.description: Libraries strive to ensure everyone can access resources, including online. This article highlights takeaways from current WCAG guidelines to help libraries consider how they can make their digital content more accessible.

item.description: Introduction to the Library Catalog, the newest on-demand course in the Library Foundational Training (LiFT) program, walks the learner through what a library catalog is, its purpose, and how it is essential to providing core library services, such as reliable access to collections. It is the first in a four-part Library Catalog Course Series.
